normalized.result: Yes, that's clear. When I hit **Get details** on something that isn't a real web address, it didn't go off trying to fetch anything or touch my bookmark count — it just flagged the box in red and told me right underneath what a proper address looks like ("like https://example.com/page"), leaving my cursor right there so I can fix it on the spot. That makes both what went wrong and what to do next obvious without any fuss. This feels right.
